name: price-of-silence
title: The price of silence
idea: With a price τ on silence, risk is E/M + τ(M − N)/M, and the best report moves with τ; your own report can be scored beside it.
from: v1 whole · v1 G-03 price-of-silence (with the your-report bar)
credit: After Kline, Rose and Walters (2024), slides 23–25, re-expressed as postrank risk.
caption: We use the normal posteriors for score A at six fictional sites from the postrank tutorial. The calculation evaluates every eligible report.
